title: Shark Pedon Se Bhi Purani Hai!
idea: Sharks have been around for about 450 million years. That makes them older than trees, dinosaurs and even the Himalayas, and they lived through all five mass extinctions.

lines.text: Shark is duniya mein pedon se bhi pehle aa gayi thi!
Shark lagbhag 45 crore saal se samundar mein tair rahi hai.
Pehle ped aaye 38.5 crore saal pehle, aur dinosaur sirf 23 crore!
Himalaya banna shuru hua sirf 5 crore saal pehle. Shark usse 9 guna purani!
Dharti pe paanch baar mahavinash aaya, dinosaur mit gaye, shark bach gayi!
Hum insaan sirf 3 lakh saal purane! Shark se bhi purana kaun? Comment karo!

youtube.title: Shark Pedon Aur Himalaya Se Bhi Purani Hai! 🦈 #shorts
youtube.description:
Shark lagbhag 45 crore saal se samundar mein hai. Yeh pedon, dinosaurs aur Himalaya se bhi pehle aa gayi thi!
Paanch mass extinctions jheli, phir bhi aaj tak zinda. Aapko pata tha? Comment mein batao!
#shorts #facts #hindifacts #shark #amazingfacts

facts.claim: The earliest shark-like fossils (scales) are about 450 million years old
The first true trees (Archaeopteris) appeared about 385 million years ago, so sharks are older than trees
The oldest well-known dinosaurs date to about 230 million years ago
The Himalayas began forming 40-50 million years ago when India collided with Eurasia
Sharks as a group have survived all five major mass extinctions
Homo sapiens has existed for about 300,000 years (Jebel Irhoud fossils)
